title: Unit tests for maxFeeMsatFor and payoutCapacityMsat (src/economy/payouts.ts)
instructions:
Add a new vitest unit test file `tests/economy/payout-fee-math.test.ts` for `maxFeeMsatFor and payoutCapacityMsat` in `src/economy/payouts.ts`.
- Read the code first (it is pasted below) and assert what it actually does; if you think the code has a bug, say so in your final answer instead of changing it.
- Use `import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";` and import the code under test with a relative path ending in `.js` (for example `../../src/economy/payouts.js`), like the other tests in this repository.
- Build the PayoutPolicy argument as a plain object cast with `as PayoutPolicy` (import the type from the same module) holding only the fields these functions read. Cover: the fee floor applies to small amounts; the basis-points cap applies to large amounts and rounds up; capacity subtracts the reserve and what is already paid or pending; capacity never goes below 0.
